title: Nine Times Table on Your Fingers
summary: Use your hands as a built-in calculator for 9s.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: How can your fingers tell you 9 times 4?
points: How can your fingers tell you 9 times 4?

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Your ten fingers can be a calculator for the nine times table.
points: Your ten fingers can be a calculator for the nine times table.

steps.title: The method: Fold the finger
sentences: To find 9 times 4, fold the fourth finger from the left.
Count the fingers to the left of it, then to the right.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: There are 3 fingers on the left and 6 on the right, so 9 times 4 is 36.
The same trick gives 9 times 7 is 63.
The digits of each answer always add up to 9.
points: There are 3 fingers on the left and 6 on the right, so 9 times 4 is 36.
